title: A structural closure of growth-sector couplings
description: This paper tests three operator-level ways that Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) could couple to the linear growth equation: a multiplicative Geff on the Poisson source, additive local friction, and additive non-local (memory) friction. Using DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic-chronometer H(z), an fσ8 compilation, and literature EG measurements, it shows that each coupling class is either structurally excluded by the data or becomes degenerate with Ωm once geometry is fixed by BAO+H(z). The conclusion is a constraint on coupling structure (not parameters): growth-only observables cannot discriminate this theory class; the next informative direction must involve lensing, gravitational slip, or cross-correlations.
author: Morten Magnusson

growth_equation_LCDM.description: Baseline linear growth equation for matter overdensity in flat ΛCDM, with primes denoting d/da and E(a)=H(a)/H0.

Geff_modification.latex: \frac{G_{\rm eff}(k,a)}{G} = 1 + (C^2 - 1)\, g(a)\, s(k),\quad g(a) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-(a-a_t)/\delta a}},\quad s(k) = \frac{1}{1 + (k/k_\Lambda)^2}
Geff_modification.description: Class A: multiplicative modification of the Poisson source by an effective gravitational coupling with a logistic temporal gate and low-pass Fourier screening.

local_friction.description: Class B: additive, local-in-time friction term proportional to β g(a)/a acting on the velocity δ'.

nonlocal_memory_kernel.description: Class C: additive non-local (memory) friction in which the logistic gate is accumulated over time, breaking Markovian evolution of δ.

background_E2.description: ΛCDM background expansion used to lock geometry (for Classes B and C; and fixed here for Class A to isolate source-side effects).

EG_statistic.description: Quasi-static EG statistic; for growth-only modifications (Σ=1) it reduces to Ωm,0/f(z), carrying no information independent of fσ8.

key_results.main_finding: All three growth-sector coupling classes are either structurally excluded by the data or absorbed by the Ωm degeneracy once BAO+H(z) lock geometry; EG with Σ=1 adds no information beyond fσ8.
parameters_tested: C ≈ 2.32 (from Grid-AQUAL sector, fixed in scans)
datasets_used: DESI DR2 BAO (DM/rd, DH/rd with full 13×13 covariance)
fσ8 compilation: 6dFGS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12 (with 3×3 covariance), VIPERS, FastSound
EG statistic: Amon et al., Reyes et al., Singh et al., Blake et al., de la Torre et al.

sealed_predictions.statement: In growth-only scenarios with Σ=1, EG(z) computed from shear–galaxy cross-correlations equals Ωm,0/f(z); conditioning on fσ8(z) and Ωm removes any independent constraining power of EG.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint RSD+lensing analyses that demonstrate statistically significant residual EG information after conditioning on fσ8 and Ωm in the quasi-static, linear regime.

sealed_predictions.statement: With BAO+H(z) fixing geometry and rd, no non-zero local or non-local friction term (β≠0) can improve growth fits across 0<z<1 without being degenerate with Ωm.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Stage-IV RSD datasets (e.g., DESI full survey) showing a >3σ preference for β≠0 after imposing BAO+H(z) priors on Ωm.

kill_criteria: KC1: A BAO+H(z)+fσ8 analysis (Planck-calibrated rd) that finds a >3σ improvement for a non-zero local (β g(a)/a) or non-local (β G(a)/a) friction term over ΛCDM after marginalizing Ωm would falsify the paper’s structural-closure claim for Classes B/C.

KC2: High-S/N joint lensing–clustering measurements that, after conditioning on fσ8 and Ωm, retain significant (>3σ) independent constraining power in EG with Σ=1 would refute the claim that EG adds no information beyond fσ8 for growth-only modifications.

KC3: Detection of a scale-dependent growth signal in fσ8(k,z) over 0.02<k<0.2 h Mpc^{-1} inconsistent with the screened form s(k) = [1+(k/k_Λ)^2]^{-1} for any k_Λ would rule out the Class A Geff operator bridge tested here.

KC4: Consistency checks showing that apparent β preferences in fσ8-only fits persist at >3σ after enforcing BAO-anchored Ωm priors would contradict the reported absorption by the Ωm–coupling degeneracy.

related_packages.role: paper archive and accompanying data/code pointers (pipelines/efc/grav_bridge)
